title: What's new: Data Analysis (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: System fields examples: sales orders and customers
System fields and bookmarking in profiles

features.name: System fields in analysis mode
features.description: Ability to use system fields (created by, created on, modified by, modified on) in analysis tabs and views. These fields exist on all tables but were not previously visible in analysis mode.

features.name: Bookmark analysis tab
features.description: Ability to bookmark an analysis tab or analysis view. Users can save analysis views for direct navigation from the role center.
features.status_evidence_quote: coming in version 29.x, hopefully here in the one of the first minor versions, is ability to bookmark an analysis tab or analysis view.
caveats: Coming in a future minor version, not in the major release

features.name: Bookmark list views
features.description: Ability to bookmark normal list views or saved filters to the role center. Users can navigate directly from the role center to saved list views.

features.name: System fields in page designer for profiles
features.description: System audit fields can be added to pages in the page designer for profiles. Allows profile-based configuration to display audit information on cards and lists.

features.name: Bookmark analysis views and list views in profiles
features.description: Ability to add bookmarked analysis tabs and list views to a role center at the profile level. All users sharing that profile will see the bookmarked views.
